text.description: One message, in Markdown, as a person would send it in Slack: a sentence or two. A workspace member's mention link becomes a real Slack mention.

channel.description: A channel the bot is in, by the id or name list_slack_channels answered; leave it and member out for your own Slack thread.

member.description: A member of your workspace to DM, by their mention link or user id.

thread.description: The `ts` of a message to reply under, in the channel, the DM, or your own thread's channel.

files.description: Pictures, recordings, or sound clips you made, each a path in your sandbox, shared as files under the message.
